title: Jeremiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 31
description: Ten questions on Jeremiah 31: the everlasting love, Rachel weeping in Ramah, and the new covenant with the house of Israel and Judah.

questions.text: With what kind of love did Yahweh say He had loved them?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "Yes, I have loved you with an everlasting love. Therefore I have drawn you with loving kindness."

answers.text: With the love of a stranger
With an everlasting love
With a love that had grown cold
With the love of a brother

questions.text: What did Yahweh say the virgin of Israel would again be adorned with?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "I will build you again, and you will be built, O virgin of Israel. You will again be adorned with your tambourines, and will go out in the dances of those who make merry."

answers.text: With crowns of gold
With fine linen
With the spoil of the nations
With her tambourines

questions.text: What would the watchmen on the hills of Ephraim cry?
questions.explanation: The text says there will be a day that the watchmen on the hills of Ephraim cry, "Arise! Let's go up to Zion to Yahweh our God."

answers.text: "Arise! Let's go up to Zion to Yahweh our God."
"The harvest is past, the summer is ended."
"Terror on every side, and no peace!"
"Flee away to the land of Egypt."

questions.text: Who are named among those Yahweh would bring from the north country and gather?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said He would bring them from the north country and gather them from the uttermost parts of the earth, along with the blind and the lame, the woman with child and her who travails with child together.

answers.text: Only the strong men of war
Only the priests and the elders
The blind, the lame and women with child
The craftsmen and the smiths

questions.text: Whom does Yahweh call His firstborn?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "for I am a father to Israel. Ephraim is my firstborn."

answers.text: Jacob
Ephraim
Judah
David

questions.text: Who is heard weeping in Ramah, refusing to be comforted?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says a voice is heard in Ramah, lamentation and bitter weeping, Rachel weeping for her children; she refuses to be comforted for her children, because they are no more.

answers.text: The virgin of Israel
The daughter of Zion
The mother of the prophet
Rachel, weeping for her children

questions.text: What did Yahweh say about Ephraim, whom He still earnestly remembered?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said that as often as He speaks against him He still earnestly remembers him, therefore his heart yearns for him, and He will surely have mercy on him.

answers.text: That his heart yearns for him and He will surely have mercy on him
That He would forget him among the nations
That He would hand him over to the strangers
That He would speak to him no more at all

questions.text: What new thing did Yahweh say He had created in the earth?
questions.explanation: The text says, "For Yahweh has created a new thing in the earth: a woman will encompass a man."

answers.text: The sun will stand still over the land
A fountain will open in the wilderness
A woman will encompass a man
The mountains around Zion will be made level

questions.text: Which saying did Yahweh say they would use no more in those days?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said they would say no more, "The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children's teeth are set on edge," but everyone would die for his own iniquity.

answers.text: "The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children's teeth are set on edge."
"Yahweh has said, 'You will have peace; no evil will come on you.' "
"Zion will be plowed as a field, and Jerusalem will become heaps."
"Who would come down against us, or enter into our homes?"

questions.text: In the new covenant He promised to make with the house of Israel and the house of Judah, where did Yahweh say He would put His law?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said of the new covenant, "I will put my law in their inward parts, and I will write it in their heart," and that He would forgive their iniquity and remember their sin no more.

answers.text: On tablets of stone in the temple
In a book kept by the priests
On the gates of the city
In their inward parts, written in their heart
